newsitem.title: UK: GKN buys 39 pct of Agrindustrial Holding.
newsitem.headline: GKN buys 39 pct of Agrindustrial Holding.

text.p: British engineering and agriculture technology group GKN Plc said on Wednesday it had bought a 39 percent stake in Agrindustrial Holding BV for 17.3 million stg.

Under the terms of the agreement, GKN will be able to buy further shares in the company and not less than 90 percent of its equity over the next five years at a price based on an earnings multiple estimated at up to 40 million stg, GKN said.
GKN said the net assets of the Dutch company totalled 15 million stg in 1995 and pre-tax profits were 2.5 million.
Agrindustrial Holding operates in Europe and South America, manufacturing wheels, hubs and brakes for agricultural and off-highway vehicles and implements.
